recipes.title: Sample Raster Elevation at Coordinates (GDAL/Rasterio)
outputs: List of sampled numeric values or NoData indicators

spatial_constraints.crs_handling: Coordinates must be transformed to match raster CRS prior to sampling
spatial_constraints.nodata_policy: Explicit check against src.nodata; returned as None or NaN

recipes.code_snippet:
import rasterio

def sample_raster(raster_path, points):
    with rasterio.open(raster_path) as src:
        # Sample generator yielding generator of float values
        sampled = [val[0] if val[0] != src.nodata else None for val in src.sample(points)]
    return sampled
recipes.known_limitations: In-memory point sampling; for millions of points use windowed chunking or GDAL point extraction.
